name: Joshua Gottheimer
page_title: Joshua Gottheimer's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic for U.S. House (NJ) - District 5

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: Rated 100% by Planned Parenthood Action Fund

"Today, I announced critical action we must take to protect a woman’s right to choose, including against new legislative threats to in vitro fertilization (IVF), to protect women’s data & privacy on reproductive health apps, & to push to fully codify Roe v. Wade into federal law."
Voted in favor of HR 8296: "Women's Health Protection Act of 2022"
Voted in favor of HR 8297: "Ensuring Access to Abortion Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "84 years ago today, Ida May Fuller received the first ever Social Security check. I will always work to protect Social Security and help my constituents receive the benefits they’ve earned."
Rated 100% by Alliance for Retired Americans
Rated 100% by National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "Today, I shared more action I’m taking on every line of the tax bill — local, state, & federal — to help lower taxes for our families and small businesses."
Rated 7% by National Taxpayers Union
Voted against HR 1 "Tax Cuts and Jobs Act"
Voted in favor of HR 5377: "Restoring Tax Fairness for States and Localities Act"

positions.question: Do you support a wealth tax in order to pay for public programs?

evidence.text: Rated 7% by National Taxpayers Union
Voted against HR 1 "Tax Cuts and Jobs Act"
Voted in favor of HR 5377: "Restoring Tax Fairness for States and Localities Act"

positions.question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations, unions, and individuals?

evidence.text: "Ten years ago, the #CitizensUnited decision allowed dark money and even foreign actors to influence our elections. The Senate needs to finally pass #HR1 so that we can restore fairness to our elections. I'm also supporting the #DemocracyForAll amendment to overturn Citizens United & put voters back in charge of our democracy. #EndCitizensUnited"
Rated 89% by Common Cause
Rated 92% by End Citizens United
Voted in favor of HR 1: "For the People Act of 2021"

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "I have great respect for our rule of law and legal system, and today, that system delivered justice for George Floyd and his family. While this is progress, we still have to do more for racial justice and equality nationwide."

"Today, I'm driving down to D.C. to vote on landmark legislation — the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act — to address racial discrimination, increase accountability, help save lives, and ensure structural reforms."

"Yesterday, I was proud to join the House in voting to pass the George Floyd #JusticeinPolicing Act. We must continue to work to increase accountability, address racial discrimination, ensure structural reforms, and help save lives."
Voted in favor of HR 1280 "George Floyd Justice in Policing Act of 2021."

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "I strongly support investing missile defense systems like Iron Dome, which help protect against threats like today’s barrage of rocket attacks on innocent civilians in Israel."
Voted in favor of HR 2670: "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024"
Voted in favor of HR 4350: "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022"
Voted in favor of HR 7900: "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023"

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "Let’s get the Bipartisan Infrastructure Bill across the finish line. No one should be holding up the President's agenda. Getting this done helps create millions of jobs. We’ll also continue to work on reconciliation, to combat climate change, repeal the SALT cap, & more."
Voted in favor of HR 1319 "American Rescue Plan Act of 2021"
Voted in favor of HR 2: "Moving Forward Act"
Voted in favor of HR 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "Proud to stand with Gina Fierro, local homeowner, realtor, and mother of three, to announce new legislation targeted at restoring property values and expanding housing access for North Jersey families"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "The newly-enacted Inflation Reduction Act is a great win for making life more affordable for North Jersey families and small businesses. This new insulin savings applies to all Medicare beneficiaries, even those that have not met their deductible."

"Today, I helped pass the Inflation Reduction Act to cut costs on prescription drugs, health care and energy, and pay down the debt — without raising taxes one penny on families and small businesses in NJ."
Voted in favor of HR 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"
Voted in favor of HR 7688: "Consumer Fuel Price Gouging Prevention Act"

evidence.text: Rated 100% by National Education Association

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "Congress is taking comprehensive action to combat #coronavirus, including free of charge coronavirus testing, paid leave for those staying home, expanded unemployment insurance, food security for kids & seniors, & support for local businesses."

"Now is the time for our country to come together — to ensure coronavirus testing is free of charge, paid leave if you need to stay home, expanded unemployment insurance, and to keep our families safe."

positions.question: Do you generally support increased regulations on social media companies (e.g. Tik Tok, Facebook, etc.)?

evidence.text: "Proud of the eight bills I helped lead that passed the House yesterday. That list includes the Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act, which protects Americans from CCP-controlled TikTok disinformation aimed at undermining out democracy."

"Using TikTok, China’s government has the ability to control what an entire generation of Americans see & consume every single day. That’s why I helped lead & overwhelmingly pass the bipartisan Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act in the House."
Voted in favor of HR 7521: "Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act"
